title: TeleGen: Improving LLM-Based Web Application Generation via Runtime Telemetry
title_zh: TeleGen：通过运行时遥测提升基于大语言模型的网页应用生成能力

paragraphs.en: Large language models can generate runnable web applications from natural-language requirements, but many generated applications still fail interactive tasks. Existing generate-execute-repair pipelines execute the generated application and use task outcomes or error messages to guide code revision. However, this feedback often misses the runtime behavior between a browser action and the final task outcome, making interaction-level failures difficult to diagnose. Therefore, we propose TeleGen , an observability-enhanced framework for LLM-based web application generation. TeleGen instruments generated applications, collects runtime telemetry during task execution, and compresses raw telemetry logs into concise briefs for repair. We evaluate TeleGen on WebGen-Bench and Web-Bench. On WebGen-Bench, TeleGen improves task success from 67.7% with repair without telemetry to 76.2%, an increase of 8.5 percentage points. On Web-Bench, it improves cumulative Pass@2 from 21.7% to 29.8%. Ablation results show that runtime telemetry provides a useful diagnostic signal, while telemetry briefs make this signal more effective and less costly to use. Further analysis shows that telemetry is especially helpful for failures involving hidden execution paths, such as navigation, form workflows, and frontend-backend coordination.

paragraphs.en: Large language models (LLMs) have made substantial progress in code generation ( Chen et al., 2021 ; Austin et al., 2021 ; Jiang et al., 2026 ; Hui et al., 2024 ) , moving from standalone programming problems ( Hendrycks et al., 2021 ; Li et al., 2022b ; Jain et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2023 ) to repository-level tasks ( Liu et al., 2024b ; Zhang et al., 2023 ; Jimenez et al., 2023 ; Wang et al., 2025 ) . Within web code generation, the task has similarly shifted from producing static webpages to building interactive web applications from requirements expressed in natural language, screenshots, or domain-specific languages ( Lu et al., 2025a ; Xiao et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2026 ; Yang et al., 2026 ; Wan et al., 2025a ; Dang et al., 2025 ) . Static web page generation asks a model to translate a visual design or screenshot into HTML/CSS that reproduces the intended layout and appearance ( Si et al., 2025 ; Wan et al., 2025b ) . Interactive web application generation goes further: the model must produce runnable website code from a high-level natural-language requirement, implementing user-facing workflows such as search, navigation, and form submission ( Xiao et al., 2025 ) . Correctness therefore depends not only on the rendered appearance or individual code fragments, but also on whether user interactions trigger the right frontend logic, state updates, and backend behavior during execution ( Mesbah et al., 2012a ) .

paragraphs.en: To improve the quality of generated code, recent work adopts a generate-execute-repair workflow ( Lu et al., 2025b ) . After generating an initial application, an execution step exercises its behavior by performing user-oriented tasks, either through browser agents that interact with the application in realistic web environments ( Deng et al., 2023 ; Zhou et al., 2024 ; He et al., 2024 ; Koh et al., 2024 ) or through end-to-end testing frameworks that programmatically verify behavior against expected outcomes Zhang et al. (2025) ; Teoh et al. (2026) ; Chevrot et al. (2025) . This step exposes failures that the source code alone does not reveal, such as a button that does not trigger its handler ( Artzi et al., 2011 ) , or a form submission that does not update the interface ( Mesbah et al., 2012b ) . When execution reveals a task failure, the repair agent ( Pabba et al., 2025 ; Maddila et al., 2025 ; Xia et al., 2023 ) receives the feedback and revises the generated code.
paragraphs.zh: 为了提高生成代码的质量，近期的研究采用了一种“生成-执行-修复”的工作流程（Lu et al., 2025b）。 在生成初始应用程序后，执行步骤会通过执行面向用户的任务来测试其行为，具体方式包括：通过浏览器智能体在真实的网络环境中与应用程序进行交互（Deng et al., 2023；Zhou et al., 2024；He et al., 2024；Koh et al., 2024），或者通过端到端测试框架以编程方式验证行为是否符合预期结果（Zhang et al. (2025)；Teoh et al. (2026)；Chevrot et al. (2025)）。 该步骤会暴露仅凭源代码无法发现的故障，例如按钮未能触发其处理程序（Artzi et al., 2011），或表单提交未能更新界面（Mesbah et al., 2012b）。 当执行过程发现任务失败时，修复智能体（Pabba et al., 2025；Maddila et al., 2025；Xia et al., 2023）会接收反馈并修改生成的代码。

paragraphs.en: While effective, this feedback is often incomplete for interactive web applications: interaction-based execution can reveal that a generated application fails a task, but it can miss critical information that is not captured through the visible UI layer alone ( Alimadadi et al., 2016 ) . As a result, the feedback that reaches the repair agent ( Fan et al., 2023 ; Bouzenia et al., 2025 ) is typically limited to task-level pass/fail outcomes or surface-level error messages. For example, after a browser agent clicks a button, the available feedback may not show if the click reached the intended event handler, sent a request, received the expected backend response, or the application state changed but was not rendered ( Jr. et al., 2017 ) . From the outside, these failures may look similar as the expected result was not reached. For repair, however, they point to different defects and require different code changes ( Jr. et al., 2016 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 尽管这种反馈方法有效，但对于交互式网络应用而言，其提供的信息往往不完整：基于交互的执行方式可以揭示生成的应用未能完成某项任务，但却可能遗漏仅通过可见用户界面层无法捕捉到的关键信息（Alimadadi 等人，2016）。 因此，传递给修复智能体的反馈（Fan 等人，2023；Bouzenia 等人，2025）通常仅限于任务层面的通过/失败结果或表层错误消息。 例如，在浏览器智能体点击按钮后，可用的反馈可能无法显示该点击是否触发了预期的事件处理程序、是否发送了请求、是否收到了预期的后端响应，或者应用状态是否已改变但未被渲染（Jr. 等人，2017）。 从外部观察，这些失败可能看起来相似，因为最终结果并未达到预期。 然而，对于修复而言，它们指向了不同的缺陷，并需要不同的代码修改（Jr. 等人，2016）。

paragraphs.en: This gap motivates our central question: can making generated applications more observable during execution provide better runtime evidence for repair? To answer it, we add an observability step before repair. Drawing on the use of observability to diagnose complex software systems ( Li et al., 2022a ; Li et al., 2021 ) , we instrument the generated application with lightweight logging mechanisms and record its runtime behavior while the browser agent executes each task. The resulting runtime telemetry ( Barik et al., 2016 ) captures interaction events, runtime errors, state changes, and other task-relevant execution signals. Rather than passing the raw telemetry logs directly to the repair agent, we employ a separate agent to compress them into a telemetry brief. Raw logs often contain duplicated messages ( Li et al., 2019 ; Li et al., 2022c ) , framework noise, and other low-level details that can obscure the evidence relevant to a failed task ( Locke et al., 2022 ) . They are also lengthy, increasing the context size and cost of each repair attempt ( Liu et al., 2024a ) . The telemetry brief is designed to preserve concise diagnostic evidence while avoiding the noise and cost of long execution logs.
paragraphs.zh: 这一空白促使我们提出核心问题：在生成式应用执行过程中，能否通过增强其可观察性，为修复提供更可靠的运行时证据？ 为回答这一问题，我们在修复流程前增加了一个可观察性步骤。 借鉴可观察性技术在复杂软件系统诊断中的应用（Li et al., 2022a；Li et al., 2021），我们为生成的应用嵌入轻量级日志记录机制，并在浏览器智能体执行每项任务时记录其运行时行为。 由此获得的运行时遥测数据（Barik et al., 2016）能够捕捉交互事件、运行时错误、状态变化以及其他与任务相关的执行信号。 我们并未将原始遥测日志直接传递给修复智能体，而是采用一个独立的智能体将其压缩为一份遥测简报。 原始日志通常包含重复消息（Li et al., 2019；Li et al., 2022c）、框架噪声及其他低层细节，这些内容可能掩盖与任务失败相关的证据（Locke et al., 2022）。 此外，原始日志篇幅较长，会增大每次修复尝试的上下文规模并增加成本（Liu et al., 2024a）。 遥测简报的设计旨在保留简洁的诊断证据，同时避免冗长执行日志带来的噪声与成本。

sents.zh: 遥测简报的设计旨在保留简洁的诊断证据，同时避免冗长执行日志带来的噪声与成本。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate our approach on two web code-generation benchmarks, WebGen-Bench ( Lu et al., 2025b ) and Web-Bench Xu et al. (2025) , covering both full web application generation and sequential web-development tasks. Across both benchmarks, adding runtime observability to the generation pipeline improves the quality of the final generated applications compared with standard generation and repair without telemetry. On WebGen-Bench, task success improves from 61.7% for the initially generated applications to 67.7% after repair without telemetry, and further to 76.2% when repair is guided by telemetry-derived evidence. At the task level, telemetry-guided generation fixes 106 tasks that the no-telemetry repair baseline fails, while losing 51 tasks solved by the baseline, giving a net gain of 55 tasks. On Web-Bench, our framework improves Pass@2 from 21.7% to 29.8%. Our further analysis shows that runtime evidence is especially useful for failures involving navigation, form and input workflows, authentication, search and filtering, and report or export behavior.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在两个网页代码生成基准数据集上对我们的方法进行了评估，即 WebGen-Bench（Lu 等人，2025b）和 Web-Bench（Xu 等人，2025），这两个数据集涵盖了完整的网页应用生成以及顺序性的网页开发任务。在这两个基准数据集上，与无遥测数据的标准生成和修复方法相比，在生成流程中加入运行时可观察性能够提升最终生成应用的质量。在 WebGen-Bench 中，初始生成应用的任务成功率从 61.7% 提升至 67.7%，而在由遥测数据推导出的证据指导下进行修复后，成功率进一步提升至 76.2%。在任务层面，由遥测数据指导的生成方法修复了无遥测修复基线未能解决的 106 个任务，同时失去了基线原本能解决的 51 个任务，净增 55 个任务。在 Web-Bench 中，我们的框架将 Pass@2 从 21.7% 提升到了 29.8%。我们的进一步分析表明，运行时证据对于涉及导航、表单和输入流程、身份验证、搜索与筛选，以及报告或导出行为的故障尤其有效。

paragraphs.en: Our contributions can be summarized as follows:
paragraphs.zh: 我们的贡献可概括如下：

paragraphs.en: We identify an observability gap in interactive web applications pipelines: existing feedback often misses the runtime behavior behind task failures.
paragraphs.zh: 我们发现交互式 Web 应用程序流程中存在一个可观察性缺口：现有的反馈常常忽略了任务失败背后的运行时行为。

paragraphs.en: We propose and evaluate an observability-enhanced framework that instruments generated applications, collects runtime logs, and compresses them into telemetry briefs for repair, improving final application quality on WebGen-Bench and Web-Bench.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出并评估了一种增强可观察性的框架，该框架对生成的应用程序进行标记、收集运行时日志，并将其压缩为用于修复的遥测摘要，从而在 WebGen-Bench 和 Web-Bench 上提升了最终应用程序的质量。

paragraphs.en: We show that telemetry is especially useful for failures involving hidden execution paths such as interaction handling, state updates, navigation, network behavior, and frontend-backend coordination.
paragraphs.zh: 我们证明，对于涉及隐藏执行路径的故障（例如交互处理、状态更新、导航、网络行为以及前端与后端的协调），遥测数据尤其有用。

paragraphs.en: Recent work has studied generating webpages and website codebases from screenshots, design inputs, interaction traces, and natural language requirements ( Si et al., 2025 ; Yun et al., 2024 ; Xiao et al., 2025 ; Lu et al., 2025b ; Lu et al., 2025a ; Li et al., 2026 ) . These tasks move beyond standalone code generation because the output must render a plausible interface and support user behavior through routing, events, state updates, and backend logic. Si et al. (2025) and Yun et al. (2024) study front end code generation from visual inputs, while Xiao et al. (2025) shows that interactive behavior remains difficult to generate reliably. Lu et al. (2025b) is closest to our study because it evaluates whether generated web applications can complete functional UI tasks. We build on this setting by studying the next step, repairing the generated application after browser evaluation exposes failed workflows.

paragraphs.en: Web agents have been widely used to test whether language models can complete user-oriented tasks through browser interaction ( Furuta et al., 2024 ; Deng et al., 2023 ; Zhou et al., 2024 ; He et al., 2024 ; Koh et al., 2024 ; Drouin et al., 2024 ; de Chezelles et al., 2025 ; Gou et al., 2025 ; Hu et al., 2025 ) . These benchmarks evaluate behavior through execution rather than static inspection. In web application generation, browser agents can also act as testers by interacting with a generated application and checking whether the expected result is reached ( Lu et al., 2025b ) . This task completion signal is useful, but it is often too coarse for repair. It can show that a workflow failed, but not whether the cause was an inactive event handler, a failed request, a missing route transition, or a state update that was not reflected in the interface. We study whether runtime evidence collected during browser execution can provide this missing diagnostic signal.

paragraphs.en: Large language models have been studied for automated program repair, including repairing incorrect programs produced by LLMs, generating patches for standard repair benchmarks, and resolving repository-level software issues ( Fan et al., 2023 ; Xia et al., 2023 ; Jimenez et al., 2023 ) . Recent repair systems further treat the model as an agent that can gather context, reason about defects, use tools, and validate candidate fixes ( Bouzenia et al., 2025 ; Pabba et al., 2025 ) . Generated web applications pose a related but different repair problem. The target is an interactive system verified through browser workflows, and the failure cause may only become visible during execution. Our work complements prior repair research by making the generated application observable during evaluation and by studying whether telemetry evidence improves repair beyond source code, task descriptions, and final outcomes.
paragraphs.zh: 大型语言模型已被用于自动化程序修复的研究，包括修复由大型语言模型生成的错误程序、为标准的修复基准生成补丁，以及解决仓库级别的软件问题（Fan 等人，2023；Xia 等人，2023；Jimenez 等人，2023）。 近期的修复系统更进一步将模型视为一个能够收集上下文、分析缺陷、使用工具并验证候选修复方案的智能体（Bouzenia 等人，2025；Pabba 等人，2025）。 生成的网络应用程序提出了一个相关但不同的修复问题。 其目标是一个通过浏览器工作流程进行验证的交互式系统，而故障原因可能仅在执行过程中才会显现。 我们的研究通过使生成的应用程序在评估过程中可被观察，并研究遥测证据是否能在源代码、任务描述和最终结果之外提升修复效果，从而对先前的修复研究进行了补充。

paragraphs.en: To study how runtime telemetry can improve LLM-generated web applications, we propose TeleGen , an observability-enhanced framework for web application generation. Figure 1 illustrates the pipeline. Given a website description, a coding agent first generates an initial application, which we call the v1 application . A task executor then runs the corresponding task suite on this application and produces task feedback, including pass/fail outcomes. Then, TeleGen adds an observability step, where it creates an instrumented copy of the v1 application and runs the same tasks on this copy. During execution, the instrumented application records runtime telemetry. These raw telemetry logs are then compressed into a telemetry brief. The repair agent receives the clean v1 source code, task feedback, and, in the TeleGen setting, the telemetry brief. It then edits the clean source code to produce a revised v2 application . Finally, the task executor re-runs the same task suite on the v2 application to measure whether the final generated application better satisfies the intended workflows.
paragraphs.zh: 为了研究运行时遥测数据如何改进由大型语言模型生成的网络应用，我们提出了 TeleGen——一个增强了可观察性的网络应用生成框架。 图 1 展示了该流程。 给定一个网站描述，编码智能体首先会生成一个初始应用，我们称之为 v1 应用。 随后，任务执行器会在这个应用上运行相应的任务套件，并生成任务反馈，包括通过/失败的结果。 接着，TeleGen 会增加一个可观察性步骤：它创建一个带有观测工具的 v1 应用副本，并在该副本上运行相同的任务。 在执行过程中，带有观测工具的应用会记录运行时遥测数据。 这些原始的遥测日志随后会被压缩成一个遥测摘要。 修复智能体将收到干净的 v1 源代码、任务反馈，以及在 TeleGen 设置下的遥测摘要。 然后，它会编辑干净的源代码，生成一个修订后的 v2 应用。 最后，任务执行器会再次在 v2 应用上运行相同的任务套件，以评估最终生成的应用是否更好地满足了预期的工作流程。

paragraphs.en: TeleGen augments existing web code-generation pipelines rather than replacing their original generation or execution protocols. For each benchmark, we therefore follow the setup used in the corresponding original work (cf. Section 4 ). For example, in WebGen-Bench ( Lu et al., 2025b ) , we use the OpenHands-based ( Wang et al., 2025 ) generation setting to produce applications from natural-language website specifications, then execute the generated applications with the benchmark’s WebVoyager ( He et al., 2024 ) UI-task protocol. Web-Bench ( Xu et al., 2025 ) is handled analogously by following its original Web Agent and Playwright-based ( Playwright, 2026 ) testing workflow.
paragraphs.zh: TeleGen 是对现有的网页代码生成流程进行增强，而非取代其原有的生成或执行协议。 因此，对于每个基准测试，我们都遵循相应原始研究中所采用的设置（参见第 4 节）。 例如，在 WebGen-Bench（Lu 等人，2025b）中，我们使用基于 OpenHands 的（Wang 等人，2025）生成设置，根据自然语言描述的网站规格生成应用程序，然后使用该基准测试中的 WebVoyager（He 等人，2024）UI 任务协议来执行生成的应用程序。 Web-Bench（Xu 等人，2025）则通过遵循其原有的基于 Web Agent 和 Playwright 的（Playwright，2026）测试流程以类似方式处理。

TeleGen keeps this feedback information unchanged at this stage. This design lets us study whether observability improves existing generate-execute-repair pipelines without changing the generator, executor, or benchmark protocol.

sents.zh: 在这些基准测试中，原始执行步骤已经提供了简单的反馈。

sents.en: This feedback may come from task outcomes, build failures ( Vassallo et al., 2020 ) , assertion mismatches ( Xie and Memon, 2007 ) , or test errors from automation frameworks ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) .
sents.zh: 这种反馈可能来自任务结果、构建失败（Vassallo 等人，2020）、断言不匹配（Xie 和 Memon，2007），或自动化框架中的测试错误（Zhang 等人，2025）。

sents.en: TeleGen keeps this feedback information unchanged at this stage.
sents.zh: TeleGen 在此阶段保持这些反馈信息不变。

sents.en: This design lets us study whether observability improves existing generate-execute-repair pipelines without changing the generator, executor, or benchmark protocol.
sents.zh: 这种设计使我们能够研究：在不改变生成器、执行器或基准测试协议的前提下，可观察性是否能改进现有的“生成-执行-修复”流程。

paragraphs.en: To collect runtime telemetry, TeleGen instruments a separate copy of the v1 application while preserving the clean v1 source for later repair. This separation keeps telemetry collection independent from the repair step and avoids confounding the repair results with possible side effects introduced during instrumentation.
paragraphs.zh: 为了收集运行时遥测数据，TeleGen 会对 v1 应用程序创建一个独立的副本，同时保留干净的 v1 源代码以便后续修复。 这种分离使得遥测数据的收集与修复步骤保持独立，并避免了修复结果受到在植入过程中可能引入的副作用的影响。

sents.en: To collect runtime telemetry, TeleGen instruments a separate copy of the v1 application while preserving the clean v1 source for later repair.
sents.zh: 为了收集运行时遥测数据，TeleGen 会对 v1 应用程序创建一个独立的副本，同时保留干净的 v1 源代码以便后续修复。

sents.en: This separation keeps telemetry collection independent from the repair step and avoids confounding the repair results with possible side effects introduced during instrumentation.
sents.zh: 这种分离使得遥测数据的收集与修复步骤保持独立，并避免了修复结果受到在植入过程中可能引入的副作用的影响。

paragraphs.en: Specifically, the instrumentation is performed by an LLM-based coding agent. Given the application source, website specification, and task suite, the agent inserts lightweight logging statements at code locations that it judges useful for diagnosing task failures. This design makes the logging repair-oriented: since the telemetry is ultimately consumed by a coding agent during repair, we ask a coding agent to decide what execution signals are likely to be useful. The prompt explicitly instructs the agent to add telemetry only, without changing application behavior.
paragraphs.zh: 具体来说，该工具化操作由一个基于大型语言模型（LLM）的智能体执行。 根据应用程序源代码、网站规格和任务集，该智能体会在其判断对诊断任务失败有用的代码位置插入轻量级的日志记录语句。 这种设计使日志记录具有修复导向性：由于遥测数据最终由智能体在修复过程中使用，因此我们让智能体决定哪些执行信号可能有用。 提示明确指示该智能体仅添加遥测数据，而不得更改应用程序的行为。

sents.en: Specifically, the instrumentation is performed by an LLM-based coding agent.
sents.zh: 具体来说，该工具化操作由一个基于大型语言模型（LLM）的智能体执行。

sents.en: Given the application source, website specification, and task suite, the agent inserts lightweight logging statements at code locations that it judges useful for diagnosing task failures.

sents.en: This design makes the logging repair-oriented: since the telemetry is ultimately consumed by a coding agent during repair, we ask a coding agent to decide what execution signals are likely to be useful.
sents.zh: 这种设计使日志记录具有修复导向性：由于遥测数据最终由智能体在修复过程中使用，因此我们让智能体决定哪些执行信号可能有用。

sents.en: The prompt explicitly instructs the agent to add telemetry only, without changing application behavior.
sents.zh: 提示明确指示该智能体仅添加遥测数据，而不得更改应用程序的行为。

paragraphs.en: After instrumentation, the task executor runs the same tasks on the instrumented application. During this run, the inserted logging statements record runtime telemetry and capture how browser actions propagate through the application. This makes intermediate application behavior visible, instead of leaving the repair agent with only the original task feedback.
paragraphs.zh: 在植入监控代码后，任务执行器会在已植入监控代码的应用程序上运行相同的任务。 在此运行过程中，插入的日志记录语句会记录运行时遥测数据，并捕捉浏览器操作如何在应用程序中传播。 这使得应用程序的中间行为变得可见，而不是让修复智能体仅获得原始任务的反馈。

sents.en: After instrumentation, the task executor runs the same tasks on the instrumented application.
sents.zh: 在植入监控代码后，任务执行器会在已植入监控代码的应用程序上运行相同的任务。

sents.en: During this run, the inserted logging statements record runtime telemetry and capture how browser actions propagate through the application.
sents.zh: 在此运行过程中，插入的日志记录语句会记录运行时遥测数据，并捕捉浏览器操作如何在应用程序中传播。

sents.en: This makes intermediate application behavior visible, instead of leaving the repair agent with only the original task feedback.
sents.zh: 这使得应用程序的中间行为变得可见，而不是让修复智能体仅获得原始任务的反馈。

paragraphs.en: The raw telemetry logs collected during task execution are not passed directly to the repair agent. Although they contain complete runtime details, they also include duplicated messages or other types of noise. Long logs further increase context cost and can make the useful evidence harder to identify ( Liu et al., 2024a ) .
paragraphs.zh: 任务执行期间收集到的原始遥测日志不会直接传递给修复智能体。 尽管这些日志包含了完整的运行时细节，但也掺杂了重复消息或其他类型的噪声。 过长的日志还会增加上下文成本，并使有效证据更难识别（Liu 等人，2024a）。

sents.en: The raw telemetry logs collected during task execution are not passed directly to the repair agent.
sents.zh: 任务执行期间收集到的原始遥测日志不会直接传递给修复智能体。

sents.en: Although they contain complete runtime details, they also include duplicated messages or other types of noise.
sents.zh: 尽管这些日志包含了完整的运行时细节，但也掺杂了重复消息或其他类型的噪声。

sents.en: Long logs further increase context cost and can make the useful evidence harder to identify ( Liu et al., 2024a ) .
sents.zh: 过长的日志还会增加上下文成本，并使有效证据更难识别（Liu 等人，2024a）。

paragraphs.en: TeleGen therefore uses a separate compression agent to convert raw telemetry logs into a telemetry brief. The agent receives the task context together with the collected logs, then preserves execution behavior that is likely to explain the failure while removing repeated or irrelevant entries. The brief is not intended to be a complete execution transcript. Instead, it gives the repair agent a compact, repair-oriented view of what happened during task execution. For example, it may show that a request succeeded but no visible update followed, or that data was loaded but no selection event occurred. Such evidence helps distinguish failures that appear similar from the final task outcome alone.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，TeleGen 使用一个独立的压缩智能体将原始遥测日志转换为遥测摘要。 该智能体接收任务上下文以及收集到的日志，然后保留可能解释故障的执行行为，同时删除重复或无关的条目。 该摘要并非旨在成为完整的执行记录。 相反，它为修复智能体提供了任务执行期间发生情况的简洁、以修复为导向的视图。 例如，它可能显示某个请求成功但随后没有可见的更新，或者数据已加载但未发生选择事件。 此类证据有助于仅根据最终任务结果区分那些看似相似的故障。

sents.en: TeleGen therefore uses a separate compression agent to convert raw telemetry logs into a telemetry brief.
sents.zh: 因此，TeleGen 使用一个独立的压缩智能体将原始遥测日志转换为遥测摘要。

sents.zh: 该摘要并非旨在成为完整的执行记录。

sents.en: Instead, it gives the repair agent a compact, repair-oriented view of what happened during task execution.
sents.zh: 相反，它为修复智能体提供了任务执行期间发生情况的简洁、以修复为导向的视图。

sents.en: For example, it may show that a request succeeded but no visible update followed, or that data was loaded but no selection event occurred.
sents.zh: 例如，它可能显示某个请求成功但随后没有可见的更新，或者数据已加载但未发生选择事件。

sents.zh: 此类证据有助于仅根据最终任务结果区分那些看似相似的故障。

paragraphs.en: After the telemetry brief is constructed, the repair agent receives the clean v1 source code together with the task description, expected result, pass/fail outcome and telemetry brief. It edits the clean v1 application rather than the instrumented copy, producing the v2 application . This separation ensures that instrumentation is used only for observation, while functional changes are made during repair. Guided by the telemetry brief, the repair agent can localize the likely cause of a failure before modifying the source code.
paragraphs.zh: 遥测简报构建完成后，修复智能体将收到干净的 v1 源代码以及任务描述、预期结果、通过/失败结果和遥测简报。 它编辑的是干净的应用程序 v1，而非经过仪器化的版本，从而生成应用程序 v2。 这种分离确保了仪器化仅用于观察，而功能上的变更则在修复过程中进行。 在遥测简报的指导下，修复智能体可以在修改源代码之前定位故障的可能原因。

sents.en: After the telemetry brief is constructed, the repair agent receives the clean v1 source code together with the task description, expected result, pass/fail outcome and telemetry brief.
sents.zh: 遥测简报构建完成后，修复智能体将收到干净的 v1 源代码以及任务描述、预期结果、通过/失败结果和遥测简报。

sents.zh: 在遥测简报的指导下，修复智能体可以在修改源代码之前定位故障的可能原因。

paragraphs.en: The v2 application is then executed with the same task suite and evaluation protocol as the original pipeline. Comparing this setting with standard repair measures whether runtime telemetry improves the final generated application.
paragraphs.zh: 随后，使用与原始流程相同的任务套件和评估协议执行 v2 应用程序。 通过将此设置与标准修复措施进行比较，判断运行时遥测数据是否能改进最终生成的应用程序。

sents.zh: 随后，使用与原始流程相同的任务套件和评估协议执行 v2 应用程序。

sents.en: Comparing this setting with standard repair measures whether runtime telemetry improves the final generated application.

paragraphs.en: We evaluate whether runtime telemetry improves LLM-based web application generation. This section describes the benchmarks, agents, models, and metrics used in our experiments. The main comparisons follow the original baselines of each benchmark (cf. Section 3.1 ), while the component-level ablation is described in Section 5.2 .
paragraphs.zh: 我们评估运行时遥测数据是否能改进基于大型语言模型（LLM）的网页应用生成。本节介绍了实验中使用的基准测试、智能体、模型和指标。主要对比遵循各基准测试的原始基线（参见第 3.1 节），而组件层面的消融分析则见第 5.2 节。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate TeleGen on two web code-generation benchmarks with different task formats. WebGen-Bench evaluates full web application generation from natural-language requirements. The input is a website specification describing the intended application and its user-facing functionality, while the expected output is a runnable multi-file web application. The generated application is tested with UI tasks, where each task contains a user goal and an expected final result. WebGen-Bench contains 101 projects and 647 UI tasks, which are grouped into Content Presentation (174 tasks), User Interaction (313 tasks), and Data Management (160 tasks).
paragraphs.zh: 我们在两个任务格式不同的网页代码生成基准数据集上对 TeleGen 进行了评估。 WebGen-Bench 用于评估根据自然语言需求生成完整网页应用的能力。 输入是一个网站规格说明，描述了目标应用及其面向用户的功能，而期望的输出则是一个可运行的多文件网页应用。 生成的应用会通过 UI 任务进行测试，每个任务都包含一个用户目标和预期的最终结果。 WebGen-Bench 包含 101 个项目和 647 个 UI 任务，这些任务被分为内容展示（174 项）、用户交互（313 项）和数据管理（160 项）。

sents.en: We evaluate TeleGen on two web code-generation benchmarks with different task formats.
sents.zh: 我们在两个任务格式不同的网页代码生成基准数据集上对 TeleGen 进行了评估。

sents.en: WebGen-Bench evaluates full web application generation from natural-language requirements.
sents.zh: WebGen-Bench 用于评估根据自然语言需求生成完整网页应用的能力。

sents.en: The input is a website specification describing the intended application and its user-facing functionality, while the expected output is a runnable multi-file web application.
sents.zh: 输入是一个网站规格说明，描述了目标应用及其面向用户的功能，而期望的输出则是一个可运行的多文件网页应用。

sents.en: The generated application is tested with UI tasks, where each task contains a user goal and an expected final result.
sents.zh: 生成的应用会通过 UI 任务进行测试，每个任务都包含一个用户目标和预期的最终结果。

sents.en: WebGen-Bench contains 101 projects and 647 UI tasks, which are grouped into Content Presentation (174 tasks), User Interaction (313 tasks), and Data Management (160 tasks).
sents.zh: WebGen-Bench 包含 101 个项目和 647 个 UI 任务，这些任务被分为内容展示（174 项）、用户交互（313 项）和数据管理（160 项）。

paragraphs.en: Web-Bench evaluates sequential web development tasks. Each project contains an initial codebase and a sequence of dependent tasks. At each step, the input is the current project state together with the next task description, and the expected output is a set of code edits that implement the requested feature. The result is checked with end-to-end tests. Web-Bench contains 50 projects, each consisting of 20 tasks. We use it to examine whether runtime telemetry remains useful when the benchmark already includes a second attempt with test-error feedback. The benchmark also provides three difficulty groups: Easy (277 tasks), Moderate (236 tasks), and Challenging (487 tasks).
paragraphs.zh: Web-Bench 用于评估顺序性的网页开发任务。 每个项目都包含一个初始代码库和一系列相互依赖的任务。 在每个步骤中，输入是当前的项目状态以及下一个任务的描述，而期望的输出是一组实现所需功能的代码修改。 结果会通过端到端测试进行验证。 Web-Bench 包含 50 个项目，每个项目由 20 个任务组成。 我们用它来检验：当基准测试已经包含了第二次尝试以及测试错误反馈时，运行时遥测是否仍然有用。 该基准测试还提供了三个难度等级：简单（277 项任务）、中等（236 项任务）和具有挑战性（487 项任务）。

sents.zh: 该基准测试还提供了三个难度等级：简单（277 项任务）、中等（236 项任务）和具有挑战性（487 项任务）。

paragraphs.en: For each benchmark, we follow its original code-agent framework and execution setup. On WebGen-Bench, we use the OpenHands-based generation setting and execute UI tasks with WebVoyager. WebVoyager interacts with the generated application through the browser and judges whether each expected result is reached. On Web-Bench, we use its own Web-Agent framework, which generates file edits for each development task and relies on Playwright-based end-to-end tests to check results.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每个基准测试，我们都遵循其原有的代码-智能体框架和执行设置。 在 WebGen-Bench 上，我们使用基于 OpenHands 的生成设置，并通过 WebVoyager 执行 UI 任务。 WebVoyager 通过浏览器与生成的应用程序进行交互，并判断是否达到了每个预期结果。 在 Web-Bench 上，我们使用其自身的 Web-Agent 框架，该框架为每个开发任务生成文件修改，并依赖基于 Playwright 的端到端测试来检查结果。

sents.zh: 对于每个基准测试，我们都遵循其原有的代码-智能体框架和执行设置。

sents.zh: 在 WebGen-Bench 上，我们使用基于 OpenHands 的生成设置，并通过 WebVoyager 执行 UI 任务。

paragraphs.en: Our main experiments use DeepSeek-V4-Flash as the text/code model for generation, telemetry insertion, telemetry-brief construction and repair. Additional results with DeepSeek-V4-Pro, Qwen3.5-Plus and Gemini-3-Flash-Preview are reported in Appendix A. For WebGen-Bench, all WebVoyager model-driven steps use Qwen3.5-Plus.

paragraphs.en: For WebGen-Bench, our main metric is task success rate, defined as the fraction of UI tasks judged successful by the browser-agent evaluator. We report overall task success and category-level success. We also report token usage to measure the context cost introduced by runtime telemetry and telemetry-brief construction.
paragraphs.zh: 对于 WebGen-Bench，我们的主要指标是任务成功率，定义为浏览器智能体评估器判定为成功的 UI 任务所占的比例。 我们报告整体任务成功率以及各类别的成功率。 我们还报告了 token 使用量，以衡量运行时遥测和遥测简报构建所引入的上下文成本。

sents.en: For WebGen-Bench, our main metric is task success rate, defined as the fraction of UI tasks judged successful by the browser-agent evaluator.

paragraphs.en: For Web-Bench, we follow the original benchmark and report Pass@1 together with cumulative Pass@2. Pass@1 measures the fraction of tasks that pass all end-to-end tests on the first attempt. Pass@2 measures the fraction of tasks passed after the retry step, where failed tasks receive error context and the agent is given a second attempt. Because TeleGen only changes the second attempt in Web-Bench, Pass@1 remains unchanged between the original and telemetry-augmented settings.

paragraphs.en: Overall, TeleGen improves the final generated applications on both benchmarks, showing that runtime telemetry is useful across both full web application generation and sequential web-development tasks. Table 1 reports the main results under the DeepSeek-V4-Flash configuration. On WebGen-Bench, the initially generated applications pass 399 out of 647 tasks, corresponding to 61.7% task success. Standard one-round repair without telemetry increases this to 438 tasks, or 67.7%. With runtime telemetry, TeleGen further improves task success to 493 tasks, or 76.2%, yielding an 8.5 percentage-point gain over the matched No-Telemetry repair baseline. The paired improvement over No-Telemetry repair is statistically significant under a two-sided exact McNemar test ( p = 1.35 × 10 − 5 p=1.35\times 10^{-5} ).
paragraphs.zh: 总体而言，TeleGen 在这两项基准测试中都提升了最终生成的应用程序，表明运行时遥测数据在完整网页应用生成和顺序网页开发任务中均具有实用价值。 表 1 报告了 DeepSeek-V4-Flash 配置下的主要结果。 在 WebGen-Bench 上，初始生成的应用程序通过了 647 项任务中的 399 项，任务成功率为 61.7%。 无需遥测数据的标准一轮修复将这一成功率提升至 438 项任务，即 67.7%。 借助运行时遥测数据，TeleGen 进一步将任务成功率提升至 493 项，即 76.2%，相比匹配的无遥测修复基线提升了 8.5 个百分点。 在无遥测修复方案上的这种成对改进，在双侧精确 McNemar 检验中具有统计学显著性（p = 1.35 × 10⁻⁵）。

paragraphs.en: Web-Bench provides a complementary setting based on sequential web-development tasks. The first-attempt Pass@1 is 14.2%, with 142 out of 1000 tasks passing before retry. paragraphs.en: The category-level results show that the improvement is not limited to easier tasks. On Easy tasks, TeleGen improves cumulative Pass@2 from 59.6% to 72.9%, suggesting that telemetry helps the agent recover failures even when the underlying task is relatively accessible. On Moderate tasks, the gain is larger in absolute terms, rising from 16.9% to 32.2%, which indicates that runtime telemetry is particularly useful when the model needs more diagnostic information to decide how to repair the code. Challenging tasks remain difficult overall, but TeleGen still improves performance from 2.5% to 4.1%. These results suggest that telemetry strengthens the original Web-Bench retry pipeline by providing additional execution context beyond standard test-error feedback, with the clearest benefit on tasks where failures are recoverable but not obvious from error messages alone.
paragraphs.zh: 类别层面的结果表明，这种改进并不仅限于较简单的任务。 在简单任务中，TeleGen 将累积 Pass@2 从 59.6% 提升至 72.9%，这表明遥测数据有助于智能体恢复失败，即使基础任务本身相对容易完成。 在中等难度任务中，绝对值的提升更大，从 16.9% 上升到 32.2%，这说明当模型需要更多诊断信息来决定如何修复代码时，运行时遥测数据尤其有用。 具有挑战性的任务总体上仍然困难，但 TeleGen 仍使性能从 2.5% 提升至 4.1%。 这些结果表明，遥测数据通过提供超出标准测试错误反馈之外的额外执行上下文，增强了原有的 Web-Bench 重试流程，其中最明显的益处体现在那些失败可以恢复但仅凭错误信息难以判断的任务中。

paragraphs.en: We conduct a step-by-step ablation of TeleGen to analyze how runtime telemetry and telemetry-brief construction contribute to performance. We perform the ablation on WebGen-Bench, where all variants start from the same generated v1 applications and use the same one-round repair protocol. Table 2 reports the results.
paragraphs.zh: 我们对 TeleGen 进行了逐步消融分析，以探究运行时遥测数据和遥测摘要构建对性能的具体影响。 我们在 WebGen-Bench 上执行了该消融实验，其中所有变体均从相同的已生成 v1 应用开始，并使用相同的单轮修复协议。 表 2 报告了实验结果。

sents.en: We conduct a step-by-step ablation of TeleGen to analyze how runtime telemetry and telemetry-brief construction contribute to performance.
sents.zh: 我们对 TeleGen 进行了逐步消融分析，以探究运行时遥测数据和遥测摘要构建对性能的具体影响。

sents.en: We perform the ablation on WebGen-Bench, where all variants start from the same generated v1 applications and use the same one-round repair protocol.
sents.zh: 我们在 WebGen-Bench 上执行了该消融实验，其中所有变体均从相同的已生成 v1 应用开始，并使用相同的单轮修复协议。

sents.en: Table 2 reports the results.
sents.zh: 表 2 报告了实验结果。

paragraphs.en: The first variant is no-telemetry repair, where the repair agent receives the standard repair inputs, including the clean v1 source code, task description, expected result and pass/fail outcome. The second variant is no-brief repair, where the repair agent additionally receives raw telemetry logs collected from the instrumented v1 application. The final variant is TeleGen , where the raw telemetry logs are compressed into telemetry briefs before repair.
paragraphs.zh: 第一种变体是无遥测修复，其中修复智能体接收标准的修复输入，包括干净的 v1 源代码、任务描述、预期结果以及通过/失败的结果。 第二种变体是无简报修复，其中修复智能体还会接收从已植入监控代码的 v1 应用程序中收集到的原始遥测日志。 最后一种变体是 TeleGen，其中原始遥测日志在修复前会被压缩成遥测简报。

paragraphs.en: Compared with no-telemetry repair, adding raw telemetry logs increases the number of passed tasks from 438 to 484, improving task success from 67.70% to 74.81%. This 7.11-point gain shows that the runtime signals collected by TeleGen contain diagnostic information that is not available from the standard repair inputs alone. In other words, the repair agent benefits from observing what happened during execution, not only from knowing the final task outcome.

paragraphs.en: Compressing raw logs into telemetry briefs further improves success to 493 passed tasks, or 76.20%. The gain over raw logs is smaller than the gain from adding telemetry itself, but it is still meaningful because both settings use the same underlying runtime information. The difference is how that information is presented to the repair agent. This suggests that telemetry is most useful when it is organized into a concise, task-centered form rather than passed as long raw logs.

paragraphs.en: Figure 2 shows the distribution of these TeleGen -only successes. Route/navigation failures form the largest group, with 33 tasks. These failures are difficult to diagnose from final outcomes because the repair agent may only know that the expected page or view did not appear. Runtime telemetry can reveal whether the click reached the intended handler, whether the route update was attempted, or whether the application remained on the same page after interaction. This helps the repair agent distinguish missing navigation links from broken routing logic or state-dependent redirects.

paragraphs.en: Form/input workflow failures are the second largest group, with 30 tasks. These failures often involve several intermediate steps between user input and visible confirmation. A form may render correctly, but the submitted values may not be captured, validation may reject the input, or the submit handler may fail to update the interface. Runtime telemetry exposes where the workflow stops, making it easier to decide whether the fix should target input binding, validation rules, handler logic or rendering after submission.

paragraphs.en: Figure 3 shows a representative form/input workflow failure from the CRM call logging application. paragraphs.en: We presented TeleGen for LLM-generated web applications. Instead of relying only on task-level pass/fail feedback, our approach instruments generated applications, collects runtime evidence during browser-based execution, compresses the resulting traces into a repair-oriented telemetry brief, and uses this evidence to guide code repair. Experiments on WebGen-Bench show that TeleGen improves task success over both initial generation and no-telemetry repair under the main DeepSeek-V4-Flash configuration. Category-level results further show gains across content presentation, user interaction, and data management projects. Our ablation demonstrates that runtime logs provide useful repair signal, while telemetry-brief compression further improves success and reduces token usage compared with using logs directly. Finally, failure-type analysis and a representative case study show that runtime evidence is especially useful for failures involving hidden interaction paths, form workflows, state transitions, and frontend–backend coordination. Overall, our results suggest that making generated web applications observable is a practical way to turn opaque browser-level failures into actionable evidence for LLM-based code repair.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了用于 LLM 生成网络应用的 TeleGen。 我们的方法不再仅依赖任务级别的通过/失败反馈，而是对生成的应用进行监控，在基于浏览器的执行过程中收集运行时证据，将生成的追踪数据压缩为以修复为导向的遥测简报，并利用这些证据指导代码修复。 在 WebGen-Bench 上的实验表明，在 DeepSeek-V4-Flash 主配置下，TeleGen 相较于初始生成和无需遥测的修复方法，能提升任务成功率。 类别级别的进一步结果显示，该方法在内容呈现、用户交互和数据管理项目中均取得了改进。 我们的消融分析表明，运行时日志提供了有用的修复信号，而遥测简报的压缩相比直接使用日志，能进一步提升成功率并减少令牌使用量。 最后，失败类型分析和一个代表性案例研究表明，运行时证据对于涉及隐藏交互路径、表单工作流、状态转换以及前端与后端协调的失败尤其有效。 总体而言，我们的研究结果表明，使生成的网络应用具备可观测性，是一种将不透明的浏览器级别失败转化为 LLM 驱动代码修复可用证据的有效实践方法。

sents.en: We presented TeleGen for LLM-generated web applications.
sents.zh: 我们提出了用于 LLM 生成网络应用的 TeleGen。

sents.en: Instead of relying only on task-level pass/fail feedback, our approach instruments generated applications, collects runtime evidence during browser-based execution, compresses the resulting traces into a repair-oriented telemetry brief, and uses this evidence to guide code repair.
sents.zh: 我们的方法不再仅依赖任务级别的通过/失败反馈，而是对生成的应用进行监控，在基于浏览器的执行过程中收集运行时证据，将生成的追踪数据压缩为以修复为导向的遥测简报，并利用这些证据指导代码修复。

sents.en: Experiments on WebGen-Bench show that TeleGen improves task success over both initial generation and no-telemetry repair under the main DeepSeek-V4-Flash configuration.
sents.zh: 在 WebGen-Bench 上的实验表明，在 DeepSeek-V4-Flash 主配置下，TeleGen 相较于初始生成和无需遥测的修复方法，能提升任务成功率。

sents.en: Category-level results further show gains across content presentation, user interaction, and data management projects.
sents.zh: 类别级别的进一步结果显示，该方法在内容呈现、用户交互和数据管理项目中均取得了改进。

sents.en: Our ablation demonstrates that runtime logs provide useful repair signal, while telemetry-brief compression further improves success and reduces token usage compared with using logs directly.
sents.zh: 我们的消融分析表明，运行时日志提供了有用的修复信号，而遥测简报的压缩相比直接使用日志，能进一步提升成功率并减少令牌使用量。

sents.en: Finally, failure-type analysis and a representative case study show that runtime evidence is especially useful for failures involving hidden interaction paths, form workflows, state transitions, and frontend–backend coordination.
sents.zh: 最后，失败类型分析和一个代表性案例研究表明，运行时证据对于涉及隐藏交互路径、表单工作流、状态转换以及前端与后端协调的失败尤其有效。

sents.en: Overall, our results suggest that making generated web applications observable is a practical way to turn opaque browser-level failures into actionable evidence for LLM-based code repair.
sents.zh: 总体而言，我们的研究结果表明，使生成的网络应用具备可观测性，是一种将不透明的浏览器级别失败转化为 LLM 驱动代码修复可用证据的有效实践方法。

paragraphs.en: While our results suggest that observability provides useful runtime evidence for repairing generated web applications, our current implementation has several limitations.
paragraphs.zh: 虽然我们的研究结果表明，可观察性为修复生成的网络应用程序提供了有用的运行时证据，但我们目前的实现仍存在若干局限性。

paragraphs.en: First, the observability layer relies on LLM-based telemetry instrumentation. Although we constrain the instrumentation model to output patches and apply these patches locally, the process can still introduce variance. The model may miss important execution points, insert noisy or redundant logs, or modify code locations that are already correct. In rare cases, instrumentation may affect application behavior rather than only exposing it. Our telemetry sanitization and compression step reduces the impact of noisy logs, but it does not fully eliminate the risk of incomplete or imperfect instrumentation.
paragraphs.zh: 首先，可观察性层依赖于基于大型语言模型（LLM）的遥测插装技术。 尽管我们将插装模型限制为仅输出补丁并在本地应用这些补丁，但该过程仍可能引入变异性。 该模型可能会遗漏重要的执行点、插入噪声日志或冗余日志，或者修改原本已正确的代码位置。 在极少数情况下，插装技术可能会影响应用程序的行为，而不仅仅是暴露其行为。 我们的遥测净化和压缩步骤可以减轻噪声日志的影响，但无法完全消除插装不完整或不完美所带来的风险。

paragraphs.en: Second, our current instrumentation strategy is intentionally conservative. The model inserts telemetry based on the source code and task context in order to expose as much potentially relevant runtime behavior as possible. This broad insertion strategy can increase runtime overhead, produce long execution logs, and consume additional storage and context budget. While the telemetry brief reduces the amount of evidence eventually provided to the repair agent, it does not remove the cost of collecting and storing the raw traces. More selective or adaptive instrumentation strategies could reduce this overhead in future work.

paragraphs.en: We further assess the task-level differences using two-sided exact McNemar tests. On WebGen-Bench, TeleGen solves 106 tasks that No-Telemetry repair fails, while No-Telemetry repair solves 51 tasks that TeleGen fails. This paired difference is statistically significant ( p = 1.35 × 10 − 5 p=1.35\times 10^{-5} ). In contrast, Raw-Telemetry and TeleGen have 56 and 65 exclusive successes, respectively, and their difference is not statistically significant ( p = 0.4672 p=0.4672 ). On Web-Bench, Original Pass2 and TeleGen Pass2 have 45 and 126 exclusive successes, respectively, yielding a statistically significant difference ( p = 4.49 × 10 − 10 p=4.49\times 10^{-10} ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们进一步使用双侧精确 McNemar 检验来评估任务层面的差异。 在 WebGen-Bench 上，TeleGen 成功解决了 No-Telemetry 修复未能解决的 106 个任务，而 No-Telemetry 修复则成功解决了 TeleGen 未能解决的 51 个任务。 这种配对差异具有统计学显著性（p = 1.35 × 10⁻⁵）。 相比之下，Raw-Telemetry 和 TeleGen 分别有 56 个和 65 个专属成功案例，其差异不具有统计学显著性（p = 0.4672）。 在 Web-Bench 上，Original Pass2 和 TeleGen Pass2 分别有 45 个和 126 个专属成功案例，产生了具有统计学显著性的差异（p = 4.49 × 10⁻¹⁰）。

paragraphs.en: Because WebGen-Bench relies on WebVoyager for task-outcome judgment, we conduct an independent human audit to assess the reliability of the automatic evaluation. The audit population contains 493 WebVoyager-judged successes and 154 judged failures under TeleGen . We use balanced stratified sampling without replacement, selecting 30 judged successes and 30 judged failures with random seed 20260713. We select at most one task per project, resulting in 60 tasks from 60 distinct projects, with no manual replacement.
paragraphs.zh: 由于 WebGen-Bench 依赖 WebVoyager 对任务结果进行判断，因此我们开展独立的人工审核，以评估自动评估的可靠性。 审核样本包含在 TeleGen 环境下由 WebVoyager 判定为成功的 493 个任务和判定为失败的 154 个任务。 我们采用不放回的平衡分层抽样方法，以随机种子 20260713 选择 30 个成功判定任务和 30 个失败判定任务。 我们从每个项目中最多选择一个任务，最终从 60 个不同项目中获得 60 个任务，且没有进行人工替换。

Overall agreement is 54/60, or 90.0% (95% CI: 79.9–95.3%), with Cohen’s κ = 0.80 \kappa=0.80 . Here, κ \kappa measures agreement between the human judgment and WebVoyager rather than agreement between multiple human annotators.
paragraphs.zh: 在 30 个自动判定为成功的案例中，人类判断与 WebVoyager 一致的比例为 28 例（93.3%；威尔逊 95% 置信区间：78.7–98.2%）；在 30 个自动判定为失败的案例中，一致的比例为 26 例（86.7%；95% 置信区间：70.3–94.7%）。 总体一致率为 54/60，即 90.0%（95% 置信区间：79.9–95.3%），科恩 κ 值为 0.80 \kappa=0.80。 此处，κ \kappa 衡量的是人类判断与 WebVoyager 之间的一致性，而非多个人类标注者之间的一致性。

paragraphs.en: We separately inspect 30 tasks sampled from the 106 cases where TeleGen succeeds but No-Telemetry repair fails. paragraphs.zh: 我们分别检查了从 106 个 TeleGen 成功但 No-Telemetry 修复失败的案例中抽取的 30 项任务。 此次审计旨在检验所测得的改进究竟是源于功能性修复，还是主要源于那些使浏览器智能体或评估器更容易观察到原本已正确结果的变化。

paragraphs.en: We categorize 24 cases as genuine functional repairs, two as mixed functional and judgeability improvements, and four as judgeability-only improvements.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将 24 个案例归类为真正的功能性修复，2 个为功能性与可判断性混合改进，4 个为仅涉及可判断性的改进。

paragraphs.en: Functional repairs change application behavior required to complete the evaluated task. Mixed cases combine a functional change with clearer evaluator-facing feedback, while judgeability-only cases make an already successful application state easier to operate or observe. Thus, 24 of the 30 audited cases are clearly functional repairs, and 26 involve at least some functional repair. The audit also shows that judgeability contributes to a minority of the measured gains.

paragraphs.en: Compared with No-Telemetry repair, TeleGen increases the average number of model calls from 24.0 to 29.5 and the API cost from $0.28 to $0.41 per project. The recorded repair-stage wall-clock times are 711, 747, and 710 seconds per project for No-Telemetry, Raw-Telemetry, and TeleGen , respectively.

paragraphs.en: The observability pipeline also has modest instrumentation and evidence overhead. Instrumentation processes 8.9 source files and modifies 7.6 files per project on average, with no recorded patch-application errors. Telemetry collection is integrated into the instrumented WebVoyager execution: No-Telemetry uses one clean WV1 execution for task feedback, whereas TeleGen uses one instrumented WV1 execution that produces both task feedback and runtime telemetry, so telemetry collection does not add another full browser-execution pass. The resulting sanitized telemetry report averages 52.9 KB per project and is compressed to a 477-byte telemetry brief, corresponding to a 99.1% reduction in evidence size.
paragraphs.zh: 可观察性流程也存在一定程度的仪器化和证据开销。 仪器化过程平均每个项目处理 8.9 个源文件并修改 7.6 个文件，且未记录任何补丁应用错误。 遥测数据收集已集成到经过仪器化的 WebVoyager 执行流程中：无遥测模式使用一次干净的 WV1 执行来获取任务反馈，而 TeleGen 模式则使用一次经过仪器化的 WV1 执行，同时生成任务反馈和运行时遥测数据，因此遥测数据收集不会增加一次完整的浏览器执行步骤。 最终生成的净化遥测报告平均每个项目为 52.9 KB，压缩后得到一份 477 字节的遥测简报，相当于证据大小减少了 99.1%。

paragraphs.en: We separate the text/code model from the browser-execution model. The text/code model is responsible for initial generation, telemetry instrumentation, telemetry-brief construction, and repair. In the main experiments, this model is DeepSeek-V4-Flash. All WebVoyager model-driven steps, including browser exploration, task execution, and final task evaluation, are routed to Qwen3.5-Plus. Additional text/code model results are reported in Appendix A .

paragraphs.en: Telemetry instrumentation is performed as an LLM-based patching step. The instrumentation model is instructed to add runtime telemetry only and not to repair functional behavior during this stage. To reduce uncontrolled edits, the model outputs code patches rather than directly modifying the workspace. These patches are then applied locally before executing the instrumented application.
paragraphs.zh: 遥测仪器的部署作为基于 LLM 的修补步骤执行。 在此阶段，仪器模型仅被指示添加运行时遥测数据，而不得修复功能行为。 为减少未经控制的修改，该模型输出代码补丁，而非直接修改工作区。 随后，在运行经过仪器化的应用程序之前，这些补丁会在本地应用。

sents.en: Telemetry instrumentation is performed as an LLM-based patching step.
sents.zh: 遥测仪器的部署作为基于 LLM 的修补步骤执行。

sents.en: The instrumentation model is instructed to add runtime telemetry only and not to repair functional behavior during this stage.
sents.zh: 在此阶段，仪器模型仅被指示添加运行时遥测数据，而不得修复功能行为。

sents.en: To reduce uncontrolled edits, the model outputs code patches rather than directly modifying the workspace.
sents.zh: 为减少未经控制的修改，该模型输出代码补丁，而非直接修改工作区。

sents.en: These patches are then applied locally before executing the instrumented application.
sents.zh: 随后，在运行经过仪器化的应用程序之前，这些补丁会在本地应用。

paragraphs.en: The no-telemetry baseline receives the task description, source code, and browser-level task feedback, but no runtime logs. The no-brief setting receives raw runtime logs collected from the instrumented application without telemetry sanitization and compression. Observable repair receives the compressed telemetry brief, which removes duplicated or irrelevant logs and preserves task-relevant observations such as navigation, user interactions, network requests, runtime errors, and state changes.
paragraphs.zh: 无遥测基线接收任务描述、源代码和浏览器级别的任务反馈，但不接收运行时日志。 无简报设置接收从已植入监控的应用程序中收集到的原始运行时日志，未经过遥测数据净化和压缩。 可观察修复接收经过压缩的遥测简报，该简报移除了重复或无关的日志，并保留了与任务相关的观察信息，例如导航、用户交互、网络请求、运行时错误和状态变化。

sents.en: The no-telemetry baseline receives the task description, source code, and browser-level task feedback, but no runtime logs.
sents.zh: 无遥测基线接收任务描述、源代码和浏览器级别的任务反馈，但不接收运行时日志。

sents.en: The no-brief setting receives raw runtime logs collected from the instrumented application without telemetry sanitization and compression.
sents.zh: 无简报设置接收从已植入监控的应用程序中收集到的原始运行时日志，未经过遥测数据净化和压缩。

sents.en: Observable repair receives the compressed telemetry brief, which removes duplicated or irrelevant logs and preserves task-relevant observations such as navigation, user interactions, network requests, runtime errors, and state changes.
sents.zh: 可观察修复接收经过压缩的遥测简报，该简报移除了重复或无关的日志，并保留了与任务相关的观察信息，例如导航、用户交互、网络请求、运行时错误和状态变化。

paragraphs.en: For observable repair, we first execute the instrumented application with WebVoyager and collect runtime observations during browser-based task execution. The collected logs are then sanitized and compressed into a repair-oriented telemetry brief. The repair agent receives this brief together with the task feedback and source code, and produces a repair patch. The repaired application is evaluated using the same WebVoyager protocol as the other settings.
paragraphs.zh: 对于可观测修复，我们首先使用 WebVoyager 执行已植入监控代码的应用程序，并在基于浏览器的任务执行过程中收集运行时观察数据。 随后，对收集到的日志进行清理和压缩，生成一份以修复为导向的遥测简报。 修复智能体接收这份简报以及任务反馈和源代码，并生成修复补丁。 使用与其余设置相同的 WebVoyager 协议来评估修复后的应用程序。

sents.en: For observable repair, we first execute the instrumented application with WebVoyager and collect runtime observations during browser-based task execution.
sents.zh: 对于可观测修复，我们首先使用 WebVoyager 执行已植入监控代码的应用程序，并在基于浏览器的任务执行过程中收集运行时观察数据。

sents.en: The collected logs are then sanitized and compressed into a repair-oriented telemetry brief.
sents.zh: 随后，对收集到的日志进行清理和压缩，生成一份以修复为导向的遥测简报。

sents.en: The repair agent receives this brief together with the task feedback and source code, and produces a repair patch.
sents.zh: 修复智能体接收这份简报以及任务反馈和源代码，并生成修复补丁。

sents.en: The repaired application is evaluated using the same WebVoyager protocol as the other settings.
sents.zh: 使用与其余设置相同的 WebVoyager 协议来评估修复后的应用程序。

paragraphs.en: For RQ2, token usage is aggregated at the project level for each repair setting. We separately record input and output tokens and report average per-project usage in the main text. The no-brief and observable settings include the additional runtime evidence provided to the repair agent, while the no-telemetry setting does not.

paragraphs.en: All experiments use proprietary API-based models. DeepSeek-V4-Flash is used as the main text/code model, while Qwen3.5-Plus is used for WebVoyager execution and screenshot-based task judgment. The exact parameter counts of these proprietary models are not publicly disclosed. We do not train or fine-tune any model. The main computational cost comes from API calls during generation, telemetry instrumentation, telemetry-brief construction, repair, and browser-based evaluation. We report token usage for the main repair settings in Table 3 . Web application execution and browser testing are run in a local sandboxed environment using the benchmark execution protocols.

paragraphs.en: This section summarizes the prompt templates used in our pipeline. The actual prompts include project-specific instructions, file paths, source code, raw telemetry logs, task feedback, and task metadata. For readability, we replace such instance-specific content with placeholders while preserving the key instructions and constraints.
paragraphs.zh: 本节总结了我们在流程中使用的提示模板。 实际的提示包括项目特定的说明、文件路径、源代码、原始遥测日志、任务反馈和任务元数据。 为了便于阅读，我们用占位符替换了这些实例特定的内容，同时保留了关键的说明和约束条件。

sents.en: This section summarizes the prompt templates used in our pipeline.
sents.zh: 本节总结了我们在流程中使用的提示模板。

sents.en: The actual prompts include project-specific instructions, file paths, source code, raw telemetry logs, task feedback, and task metadata.
sents.zh: 实际的提示包括项目特定的说明、文件路径、源代码、原始遥测日志、任务反馈和任务元数据。

sents.en: For readability, we replace such instance-specific content with placeholders while preserving the key instructions and constraints.
sents.zh: 为了便于阅读，我们用占位符替换了这些实例特定的内容，同时保留了关键的说明和约束条件。

paragraphs.en: The initial generation prompt asks the text/code model to generate a complete runnable web application from the website specification and UI task suite. This step follows the original generation protocol of the benchmark. It does not include telemetry instrumentation; telemetry is inserted later on a separate copy of the generated v1 application.
paragraphs.zh: 初始生成提示要求文本/代码模型根据网站规格和 UI 任务集生成一个完整的可运行 веб 应用程序。 此步骤遵循基准测试的原始生成协议。 该步骤不包含遥测仪器；遥测将在后续阶段插入到已生成的 v1 应用程序的独立副本中。

sents.en: The initial generation prompt asks the text/code model to generate a complete runnable web application from the website specification and UI task suite.
sents.zh: 初始生成提示要求文本/代码模型根据网站规格和 UI 任务集生成一个完整的可运行 веб 应用程序。

sents.en: This step follows the original generation protocol of the benchmark.
sents.zh: 此步骤遵循基准测试的原始生成协议。

sents.en: It does not include telemetry instrumentation; telemetry is inserted later on a separate copy of the generated v1 application.
sents.zh: 该步骤不包含遥测仪器；遥测将在后续阶段插入到已生成的 v1 应用程序的独立副本中。

paragraphs.en: Telemetry instrumentation is performed as an LLM-based patching step on a separate copy of the v1 application. The instrumentation model receives the task context and one source file at a time, and returns structured patch operations rather than directly modifying the workspace. This design allows us to inspect and apply instrumentation locally, while preserving the clean v1 source code for repair.
paragraphs.zh: 遥测仪器化作为基于 LLM 的修补步骤，在 v1 应用程序的一个独立副本上执行。 仪器化模型每次接收任务上下文和一个源文件，并返回结构化的修补操作，而不是直接修改工作区。 这种设计使我们能够本地检查和应用仪器化，同时保留干净的 v1 源代码以供修复。

sents.en: Telemetry instrumentation is performed as an LLM-based patching step on a separate copy of the v1 application.
sents.zh: 遥测仪器化作为基于 LLM 的修补步骤，在 v1 应用程序的一个独立副本上执行。

sents.en: The instrumentation model receives the task context and one source file at a time, and returns structured patch operations rather than directly modifying the workspace.
sents.zh: 仪器化模型每次接收任务上下文和一个源文件，并返回结构化的修补操作，而不是直接修改工作区。

sents.en: This design allows us to inspect and apply instrumentation locally, while preserving the clean v1 source code for repair.
sents.zh: 这种设计使我们能够本地检查和应用仪器化，同时保留干净的 v1 源代码以供修复。

paragraphs.en: The task context supplied to the instrumentation model contains the website specification, project category metadata, and the UI task suite with expected behaviors. This context is used only to identify task-relevant execution paths for telemetry, not to repair the application.
paragraphs.zh: 提供给仪器化模型的上下文信息包含网站规范、项目类别元数据以及带有预期行为的 UI 任务集。 此上下文仅用于识别与任务相关的遥测执行路径，而非修复应用程序。

sents.en: The task context supplied to the instrumentation model contains the website specification, project category metadata, and the UI task suite with expected behaviors.
sents.zh: 提供给仪器化模型的上下文信息包含网站规范、项目类别元数据以及带有预期行为的 UI 任务集。

sents.en: This context is used only to identify task-relevant execution paths for telemetry, not to repair the application.
sents.zh: 此上下文仅用于识别与任务相关的遥测执行路径，而非修复应用程序。

paragraphs.en: The telemetry brief construction prompt compresses raw telemetry logs into a concise, repair-oriented summary. It removes duplicated or irrelevant entries while preserving task-relevant runtime evidence. The brief is not intended to be a complete execution transcript; it summarizes what happened during execution in a form that is useful for repair.
paragraphs.zh: 遥测简报构建提示将原始遥测日志压缩为简洁且以修复为导向的摘要。 它会删除重复或无关的条目，同时保留与任务相关的运行时证据。 该简报并非旨在成为完整的执行记录；它以对修复有用的形式总结了执行过程中发生的情况。

sents.en: The telemetry brief construction prompt compresses raw telemetry logs into a concise, repair-oriented summary.
sents.zh: 遥测简报构建提示将原始遥测日志压缩为简洁且以修复为导向的摘要。

sents.en: It removes duplicated or irrelevant entries while preserving task-relevant runtime evidence.
sents.zh: 它会删除重复或无关的条目，同时保留与任务相关的运行时证据。

sents.en: The brief is not intended to be a complete execution transcript; it summarizes what happened during execution in a form that is useful for repair.
sents.zh: 该简报并非旨在成为完整的执行记录；它以对修复有用的形式总结了执行过程中发生的情况。

paragraphs.en: The three repair prompts differ only in the runtime evidence available to the repair agent. No-telemetry repair receives task feedback without runtime telemetry. No-brief repair receives raw telemetry logs. TeleGen receives the compressed telemetry brief. All repair variants edit the clean v1 source code rather than the instrumented copy.
paragraphs.zh: 这三个修复提示仅在于修复智能体可获取的运行时证据不同。 无遥测修复在缺乏运行时遥测数据的情况下接收任务反馈。 无简报修复接收原始的遥测日志。 TeleGen 接收压缩后的遥测简报。 所有修复变体都编辑干净的 v1 源代码，而非经过插装的版本。

sents.en: The three repair prompts differ only in the runtime evidence available to the repair agent.
sents.zh: 这三个修复提示仅在于修复智能体可获取的运行时证据不同。

sents.en: No-telemetry repair receives task feedback without runtime telemetry.
sents.zh: 无遥测修复在缺乏运行时遥测数据的情况下接收任务反馈。

sents.en: No-brief repair receives raw telemetry logs.
sents.zh: 无简报修复接收原始的遥测日志。

sents.en: TeleGen receives the compressed telemetry brief.
sents.zh: TeleGen 接收压缩后的遥测简报。

sents.en: All repair variants edit the clean v1 source code rather than the instrumented copy.
sents.zh: 所有修复变体都编辑干净的 v1 源代码，而非经过插装的版本。

paragraphs.en: All repair prompts receive a dynamically constructed task evidence block describing the application purpose, expected task behavior, and v1 task executor outcomes.
paragraphs.zh: 所有修复提示都会收到一个动态构建的任务证据块，其中描述了应用目的、预期的任务行为以及 v1 任务执行器的结果。
